about: What the Ouro AX X-ray (ouro-ui-apple, pinned in Package.swift) proves about Spoonjoy's App Intents on every pull request: the metadata of the iOS app the App bundle job builds. scripts/check-xray.rb holds the report to this file. Claims under hold must hold; failing claims are known gaps with an owner; open claims can't be settled in this lane, and each says why.

failing.entity.properties: no entity exposes @Property values yet; adding them (with descriptions behind the 27.3 SDK fence) is the Siri AI pull request's work
failing.entity.transferable: 7 of 10: access keys and account connections are deliberately not Transferable (they would carry credentials out of the app), and the cooking step, which lives only while cook mode is open, isn't yet

open.intent.tool: needs the Xcode 27.3 SDK: earlier metadata cannot mark tool intents
open.intent.error-names-fix: behaviour stage, refusal runs: only against a disposable device and backend (--disposable), and BootstrapDebug talks to production
open.intent.confirms-what-others-see: a person: run the delete, remove, revoke and disconnect intents in Shortcuts and Siri and check each asks first
open.intent.reads-in-shortcuts: a person: read each intent's summary in the Shortcuts action library
open.intent.siri-calls: SiriEvaluations: needs a 27.3 OS on an Apple Intelligence device
open.intent.siri-says-what-happened: SiriEvaluations: needs a 27.3 OS on an Apple Intelligence device
open.entity.property-description: needs entity properties first (see entity.properties), then the Xcode 27.3 SDK
open.entity.private-properties: a person: review each property once entities expose them

open.entity.transfer-round-trip: behaviour stage: the main-only App Intents behaviour job
